description: Conventional commits, auto-branch/PR on run completion, commit-msg hook enforcement, and dashboard item drawer cycling

items.user_story: As an agent running ralf run, I follow conventional commit format so that the git history is structured and readable
items.description: Update ralf-run SKILL.md Step 7 with conventional commit format guidance — type from agent judgment, scope is board name, item ID in body
items.end_state: SKILL.md Step 7 contains conventional commit format instructions with examples for common types (feat, fix, test, docs, refactor, chore) and shows item ID placement in the commit body
steps_to_verify: Read cli/src/skills/ralf-run/SKILL.md and confirm Step 7 describes conventional commit format
Confirm the format shows scope as board name and item ID in the body
Confirm examples cover at least feat, fix, test, docs types

items.user_story: As the CLI, I can perform git operations reliably so that branch/PR automation and hook management work correctly
items.description: Create cli/src/lib/git.ts with utilities: isDirty, getDefaultBranch, listBranches (local+remote), nextBranchName, createAndCheckoutBranch, push, createPr, installCommitMsgHook
items.end_state: cli/src/lib/git.ts exports all listed functions, each using execFileAsync for git/gh commands with proper error handling. Unit tests pass.
steps_to_verify: File cli/src/lib/git.ts exists and exports isDirty, getDefaultBranch, listBranches, nextBranchName, createAndCheckoutBranch, push, createPr, installCommitMsgHook
isDirty returns true when there are staged or unstaged changes to tracked files
getDefaultBranch reads from git config or falls back to 'main'
listBranches returns both local and remote branches matching a prefix
nextBranchName returns <board>-1 when no prior branches exist, increments otherwise
installCommitMsgHook writes a commit-msg hook that validates conventional commit format
npm test passes with tests covering the git module

items.user_story: As a developer, my commits are validated against conventional commit format so the repo stays consistent
items.description: Wire installCommitMsgHook into ralf init — installs a commit-msg hook that rejects non-conventional commits with a helpful error message
items.end_state: Running ralf init installs a commit-msg hook in .git/hooks/commit-msg. The hook validates the subject line matches conventional commit format (type(scope): description). Invalid commits are rejected with an error showing the expected format. Existing ralfie-owned hooks are overwritten; non-ralfie hooks are preserved with a warning.
steps_to_verify: Run ralf init and confirm .git/hooks/commit-msg exists and is executable
The hook file contains a ralfie marker comment for identification
A commit with message 'bad commit' is rejected with a helpful error
A commit with message 'feat(my-board): add feature' is accepted
A commit with message 'fix(my-board): resolve bug\n\nMY-1' is accepted
Running ralf init when a non-ralfie commit-msg hook exists prints a warning and does not overwrite it

items.user_story: As a user running ralf run, my work is automatically isolated on a new branch so I don't pollute the default branch
items.description: At the start of ralf run, check for dirty working tree (abort if dirty), compute next branch number by checking local+remote branches, create and checkout the new branch
items.end_state: ralf run my-board creates branch my-board-1 (or next increment) and checks it out. If the working tree has uncommitted changes, it aborts with a message telling the user to clean up before running.
steps_to_verify: Running ralf run with a dirty working tree prints an error and exits without starting
Running ralf run with a clean tree creates a new branch named <board>-N and checks it out
If my-board-1 exists locally, it creates my-board-2
If my-board-2 exists on remote but not locally, it creates my-board-3
git branch --show-current returns the new branch name after ralf run starts

items.user_story: As a user, when a board's work is complete I get a ready-for-review PR automatically so I can go straight to code review
items.description: When ralf run detects all items are done/verified, push the branch and create a PR via gh pr create with title from board description and body containing a checklist of completed item IDs and descriptions
items.end_state: On completion, the branch is pushed to origin and a PR is created. PR title is the board description. PR body contains a markdown checklist of all items (- [x] ITEM-1: description). Base branch is the default branch from git config. The PR URL is printed to the console.
steps_to_verify: When all items are done, ralf run pushes the current branch to origin
A PR is created via gh pr create targeting the default branch
PR title matches the board description
PR body contains a checklist with all item IDs and descriptions
The PR URL is printed to stdout
If gh is not installed, a clear error message is shown before the run starts

items.user_story: As a dashboard user, I can cycle through items of the same status without closing the drawer so I can review items faster
items.description: Add prev/next navigation to the item drawer — chevron up/down buttons in the drawer header and keyboard arrow up/down support, cycling within the same status column with wrap-around
items.end_state: Item drawer shows chevron-up and chevron-down buttons. Clicking them or pressing arrow up/down navigates to the prev/next item within the same status. Cycling wraps around (first item up goes to last, last item down goes to first). The drawer updates in place without closing.
steps_to_verify: Open an item drawer from the kanban board
Chevron up and chevron down icons are visible in the drawer header
Clicking chevron down navigates to the next item in the same status column
Clicking chevron up navigates to the previous item in the same status column
Pressing arrow down key navigates to the next item
Pressing arrow up key navigates to the previous item
At the last item, pressing down wraps to the first item in that status
At the first item, pressing up wraps to the last item in that status
The drawer content updates without closing and reopening
